name: Refined
author: LizardMan
description: Audivit's palette for the whole OP-1, its own screens included (above, on the tape screen): cyan, mint, off-white and red on the encoders, neutral off-white and greys for TE's lavender whites and purple greys, teal and aubergine for the dark blues. The first palette theme: every stock screen, text, the font's coloured icons and every plugin page drawn in stock colours take its colours.
